name: Dendrite size and reach
strongest_loadings: higher dendrite max euclidean dist; higher longest dendrite path from cell body (micrometres); higher dendrite spread, horizontal (micrometres)

name: Axon size and spread
strongest_loadings: higher total axon length (micrometres); higher axon above dendrite (log fraction); higher longest axon path from cell body (micrometres)

name: Dendrite branching
strongest_loadings: higher number of dendrite tips; higher number of dendrite branch points; higher number of primary dendrites

name: Axon branching
strongest_loadings: higher number of axon branch points; higher maximum axon branch order; higher number of axon tips

name: Axon vertical extent
strongest_loadings: higher axon bifurcation standard deviation; higher axon spread, vertical, robust (micrometres); higher axon above dendrite (log fraction)
